explanation: The order is butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke, freestyle. Medley relays begin with backstroke instead, because backstrokers start in the water rather than diving from the blocks.

claims.text: In an individual medley, butterfly is swum first, followed by backstroke, breaststroke and freestyle.
Backstroke, breaststroke and freestyle are the second, third and fourth legs of an individual medley.
A medley relay is swum in the order backstroke, breaststroke, butterfly, freestyle.
Backstroke swimmers start in the water rather than diving from the starting blocks.
